tools.name: make_class_diagram
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a UML class diagram drawn, for example "draw a class diagram of these classes" or "make a PDF of my domain model with inheritance and composition". Takes the diagram text in a strict grammar, a page size and an optional title. Grammar: One item per line. Classes: "class

tools.description: Use this when the user wants class diagram text checked without a drawing, for example "check my class diagram for errors" or "are there inheritance cycles in this model".
